title: T-3 wrangler.toml commits stable DO class names on both binding blocks and a migrations tag records the mint classes
asA: operator applying platform-cloudflare-durable-objects on a fresh Workers project
iWant: the generated wrangler.toml to carry [[durable_objects.bindings]] blocks and a paired [[migrations]] block with a stable tag
soThat: a future rename lands as a wrangler migration rather than a silent rewire and the DO class identity survives the mint

acceptanceCriteria.description: The fixture wrangler.toml carries at least two [[durable_objects.bindings]] blocks (one binding named CELL with class_name SingleCellObject; one binding named HUB with class_name HubObject) and at least one [[migrations]] block with tag "v1" and new_sqlite_classes = ["SingleCellObject", "HubObject"]. The anatomy assertion greps the toml for each literal string and the migrations pair.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the anatomy assertion greps for the four literal strings and the migrations pair (new_sqlite_classes plus the two class names)
acceptanceCriteria.then: every string is present and the migrations tag "v1" carries the two class names
